name: Maya
description: 🖥️ 📱 ▶️ Wrap your iPhone screen recordings in a beautiful device frame, add cinematic zoom moments, and export ready-to-share videos.
readme_summary: Maya is a native macOS application designed to enhance iPhone screen recordings by adding professional visual elements. It allows users to wrap recordings in device frames, incorporate cinematic zoom effects, add visible tap feedback, and export polished videos suitable for marketing, social media, or tutorials.
key_features: Device framing with multiple iPhone/iPad/MacBook models and color variants
Customizable generic frames and no-frame option
Background customization (None, Solid, Gradient, Image, Video Blur)
Timeline editing for trimming, speed adjustments (0.25x to 4x)
Cinematic zoom events with customizable timing, scale, and animation
Visible tap feedback (Ripple, Pulse, Ring) with direct placement and customization
Export to .mov with HEVC + alpha support for transparent backgrounds
primary_use_case: Transforming raw iPhone screen recordings into professional, shareable video content for marketing, social media, and tutorials.
cover_image_prompt: A magical artisan, named 'Maya', stands in a sleek, modern workshop, holding a raw, unedited iPhone screen recording like a piece of rough clay. With a glowing chisel and a digital brush, Maya is expertly sculpting the recording, wrapping it in a polished iPhone frame, adding dynamic zoom lines that swirl around it, and embedding glowing 'tap' icons. The raw recording transforms into a vibrant, ready-to-share video clip displayed on a floating screen. Subtle UI elements and data streams flow around Maya, hinting at the app's functionality. The scene is illuminated with a soft, creative glow, set against a clean, minimalist background. The style is a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clarity and visual storytelling.

name: crosspaste-desktop
description: Cross-device clipboard sync for macOS, Windows & Linux — end-to-end encrypted, LAN-only, no cloud. OCR, CLI and MCP server built in.
readme_summary: CrossPaste Desktop is a cross-platform application for synchronizing clipboard content between macOS, Windows, and Linux devices. It prioritizes privacy with end-to-end encryption and a serverless, LAN-only architecture, also featuring OCR and CLI capabilities.
key_features: Rich Type Support (Text, Color, URL, HTML, RTF, Image, File)
primary_use_case: Seamlessly synchronize clipboard content across multiple devices on a local network, ensuring privacy and security.
cover_image_prompt: A conceptual illustration of a magical, interconnected network of diverse devices (laptop, desktop, tablet) floating in a serene, cloudless sky. Each device has a glowing, ethereal stream of data flowing from its clipboard icon to the others, representing seamless content sharing. Subtle visual cues like a lock icon on the streams indicate end-to-end encryption. In the foreground, a small, stylized 'CrossPaste' logo is subtly integrated. The overall mood is one of effortless connectivity and secure data transfer. The art style should be a clean, modern 3D isometric illustration with a soft, inviting color palette.

name: cashclaw
description: An autonomous agent that takes work, does work, gets paid, and gets better at it.
readme_summary: CashClaw is an open-source autonomous agent built with TypeScript that connects to the Moltlaunch marketplace to find, bid on, and complete tasks. It utilizes an LLM for task execution and incorporates a feedback loop to continuously improve its performance over time.
key_features: Self-learning and improvement based on feedback
Tool-use for various agent actions (quote, decline, message, etc.)
Local dashboard for setup and monitoring
primary_use_case: To automate the process of finding, bidding on, executing, and learning from tasks in an onchain work marketplace, acting as a self-improving digital worker.
cover_image_prompt: A diligent, stylized robotic arm meticulously sorting and assembling glowing puzzle pieces representing tasks. On one side, a stream of diverse task icons flows into the arm, while on the other, completed puzzle pieces with positive rating symbols emerge. Subtle digital particles and a small, clean UI overlay showing progress metrics connect the metaphor to software. The background is a clean, abstract digital landscape with a soft, inviting glow. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a bright, optimistic color palette, emphasizing efficiency and learning.

name: davy
readme_summary: DAVY is a modern Android TV application built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for discovering and watching anime from the current season. It features a TV-friendly interface, a built-in media player powered by ExoPlayer, and pulls data from the Yummy API for a seamless discovery-to-playback experience.
primary_use_case: Watching current season anime on Android TV devices.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, glowing remote control acting as a magic wand, conjuring vibrant anime scenes and episode lists from a swirling vortex of data. The remote hovers over a sleek, modern Android TV interface displayed on a large screen in the background. Subtle digital particles and lines of code flow from the vortex towards the remote, representing the data being processed. The overall mood is futuristic and engaging, with a focus on ease of use and entertainment. The art style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic and a vibrant color palette, emphasizing the 'discovery to playback' journey.

name: nyetdb
description: Read-only database access for AI agents. Your agent can look; for everything else — nyet.
readme_summary: NyetDB is a Rust-based CLI tool designed to provide AI agents with secure, read-only access to various databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis). It acts as a secure gateway, preventing unauthorized write operations and protecting sensitive data through multiple layers of security and logging.
key_features: Read-only access across multiple database types
Layered security: AST validation, session modes, read-only roles
Project-scoped connections based on directory access
Password management, keeping credentials out of agent reach
PII column protection and data masking
Query planning and cost estimation guardrails
Comprehensive audit logging of all agent interactions
primary_use_case: To enable AI agents to safely query databases without the risk of accidental data modification or unauthorized access, by providing a secure, read-only interface.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, ancient librarian stands at a grand, ornate desk, holding a single, glowing key. Before the librarian is a vast, dimly lit library filled with countless books representing databases. The librarian is carefully handing a small, transparent data orb containing only 'SELECT' symbols to a curious, stylized AI robot. The robot is reaching out, but its other hand is gently but firmly held back by an invisible barrier emanating from the librarian's desk, symbolizing the read-only restriction. Subtle digital streams of 'read-only' data flow from the library to the robot's orb. The overall mood is one of controlled access and secure knowledge transfer. 3D isometric illustration style, clean lines, soft ambient lighting, with the repository name 'nyetdb' subtly etched on the librarian's desk.
